topics.title: 紧凑的历史证据读出
topics.question: 哪些目标匹配、时间和行为统计具有独立收益，能否用更紧凑的表示保留这些收益？
topics.hypothesis: 少量直接暴露的统计证据可能比持续追加完整向量更容易被预测头利用；重复特征和等容量替换应作为对照。

topics.title: Complementarity of compact statistics and grouped history evidence
topics.question: Do count/freshness statistics add predictive utility to match-group history evidence beyond either source alone, after controlling for capacity, redundancy, and measured cost?
topics.hypothesis: The full-mean versus scalar-only result suggests representation matters within the compact-evidence branch, but does not establish compatibility with match groups. Count/freshness evidence may complement grouped readout; failure to exceed the stronger frozen source under matched-capacity and redundancy controls would leave this complementarity unsupported.

topics.title: Incremental compact evidence beyond exchangeable joint histories
topics.question: Does combining the compact-statistics/grouped-history source with exchangeable_joint outperform both frozen source bests, especially exchangeable_joint, under the frozen information and training protocol with capacity, redundancy, and measured cost controlled?
topics.hypothesis: The current source inherits count/freshness evidence and match_groups; the other source supplies the stronger exchangeable_joint representation. Compact evidence may improve access to information beyond exchangeable_joint, but shared grouped-history ancestry could make the sources redundant. Predict an advantage over both frozen source bests that survives matched-capacity and duplicated-evidence controls and repetition. Failure to exceed exchangeable_joint, or an advantage reproduced by added capacity or duplicated evidence, would leave complementarity unsupported. Measure parameter count and training/inference cost against both sources; predictive gain alone does not establish efficiency or a mechanism.

decisions.reason: Compact statistics and match groups provisionally improve AUC over their entry/shared DIN reference by 0.005302 and 0.005438. Complementarity remains untested. Retain both source bests; require improvement over match_groups (0.618800 AUC), with matched-capacity and redundancy controls and measured training/inference cost. Source sizes are 17,134,371/17,136,931 parameters; inference is 16.613/15.893 seconds. Single-seed gains need repetition and need not add.

decisions.reason: Freshness improves both equal-parameter presence controls, while exclusivity helps only with freshness; redundancy and interaction remain unresolved. The single-seed best exceeds global_norm by only 0.000163 AUC, with worse logloss and 4.5% longer inference. Continue with frozen source utility controls plus global_norm, matched-capacity redundancy contrasts and measured cost; failure to beat the stronger source leaves complementarity unsupported.

Current oldest_bound gains 0.001792 AUC over its match_groups entry; exchangeable_joint gains 0.008516 over DIN and exceeds oldest_bound by 0.001286. Recent closure contrasts have opposite signs across windows and do not establish a general benefit. Allocate to unresolved compatibility with the stronger representation, retaining both frozen source bests, capacity/redundancy controls, repetition, and measured training/inference cost. Shared ancestry makes additive gains uncertain; all gains remain single-seed provisional.

topics.title: 历史表示与网络结构
topics.question: 在相同可见历史下，事件、行为组或字段组的表示粒度怎样影响信息保留和计算成本？
topics.hypothesis: 改变表示单元和信息流可能比单一混合历史向量更有效；允许完整重写Model，需与同信息范围的简单汇总比较。

decisions.reason: match_groups achieved AUC 0.618800 versus 0.616923 for rank_groups and 0.617442 for occupied_global at equal parameter counts, with lower observed training and inference times. Continue testing representation granularity with repetition and simpler same-information, capacity/cost controls: semantic matching versus occupancy remains unresolved, and the single-seed gain is provisional. Compatibility with other topics is untested.

The pooled parent reproduces AUC 0.620094; event_energy, bundle_product and field_product reach only 0.619524–0.619705 at identical parameter count, with mixed latency (18.78–20.18s versus 19.21s). Continue a bounded representation-sufficiency/cost question using the frozen parent, capacity-matched and redundancy controls. Failure of simpler group summaries to retain AUC at lower measured cost would close this branch. Single-seed results do not establish a mechanism. Active topics g0-t001 and g3-t001 already cover statistics and target-conditioning combinations, so another merge would duplicate allocation.

Product variants exceed matched-parameter joint variants by 0.000417–0.000461 AUC, but gap conditioning adds only 0.000023 AUC to independent_product. Continue the representation question with factorization and gap controls, repetition, and calibration/cost comparisons: these same-seed gains are provisional, gap_product has worse logloss, and inference takes about 27 seconds versus DIN’s 16 seconds. The mechanism and robustness remain unresolved.

lanes.active_topic_title: Measured cost frontier at the stronger direct_lifted utility level

topics.title: 目标条件信息交互
topics.question: 当前广告字段应怎样读取与融合不同历史证据，才能超过目标无关选择与幅度控制？
topics.hypothesis: 合适的目标条件读出可能利用紧凑语义关系，但不能预设复杂联合或独立注意力一定优于简单控制。

topics.title: Information sufficiency and measured cost of strong history representations
topics.question: Can a simpler representation of the same visible history retain the frozen joint_identity reference's predictive utility at lower measured training or inference cost, and which history relationships are necessary for that utility?
topics.hypothesis: The joint_identity result motivates a utility-retention study but does not establish event binding as its mechanism. Compact summaries may retain its utility at lower cost. Compare replacements against frozen joint_identity and DIN, including matched-capacity controls and category-brand pairing disruption that preserves field marginals and behavior/age information. A selective loss after disruption would provisionally support a role for pairing; equal losses under generic disruption or capacity controls would weaken that explanation. Failure to retain utility with cheaper summaries would reject those implementations, not prove that compression is impossible. Repeat promising contrasts within the remaining budget and assess uncertainty before claiming retained utility or a mechanism.

topics.title: Measured cost frontier at the stronger direct_lifted utility level
topics.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, can a simpler replacement retain the frozen direct_lifted reference's predictive utility at lower measured training or inference cost, and does it improve the frontier relative to pooled_observed and sketch256?
topics.hypothesis: The substantial utility gap between direct_lifted and sketch256 makes efficiency established against joint_identity insufficient evidence of efficiency at the stronger utility level. A simpler replacement may retain direct_lifted utility, but this transfer is unverified. Retain frozen direct_lifted, pooled_observed and sketch256 as controls; predeclare a utility-retention margin and compare AUC, logloss, parameter counts and repeated training/inference timings under identical measurement conditions. Use matched-capacity replacement controls to distinguish representation effects from capacity, and distinguish information-changing replacements from execution-only changes. Failure to retain utility within the margin, or absence of a reproducible cost reduction, falsifies the proposed efficiency benefit. Single-seed utility differences and timing noise remain alternative explanations; neither source scores nor execution-only equivalence establish a representation mechanism. Reserve resources for attribution and final assessment before expanding the search.

decisions.reason: Equal-parameter target/context contrasts favor target readout, but mixed_target only ties target_separate. The single-seed AUC gain over DIN remains provisional, with slower inference (18.35s versus 16.01s). Continue with target-independent and magnitude-matched controls, capacity/cost accounting, and repetition: disappearance of the gain would weaken the conditioning explanation. Grouped-history compatibility is already assigned to g3-t001; isolate the current topic's unresolved mechanism before duplicating that allocation.

After 48 attempts, the latest four target/context and event/independent trials did not exceed the current best AUC of 0.616587; grouped history plus target conditioning is already active in g3-t001. Switch to utility retention and cost using joint_identity (AUC 0.620426; inference 19.22s versus DIN 16.01s). Single-seed gains do not establish a mechanism. Preserve frozen utility references, control capacity, measure training and inference cost, and test information sufficiency before attributing the gain.

decisions.reason: sketch256 nearly retains joint_identity AUC (0.620337 versus 0.620426). Against exact_replay, inference improves (18.15 versus 19.11 seconds) while training slows (520.88 versus 499.41 seconds). These single-seed results establish neither reference-relative savings nor pairing necessity. Continue with a prespecified retention tolerance, direct reference cost measurements, matched-capacity controls, and marginal-preserving category-brand pairing disruption. Reserve replication and compare utility and measured cost with the stronger gap_joint reference; its mechanism remains unverified.

After 45 attempts, the current best remains 0.000089 AUC below its joint_identity entry; recent execution variants preserve AUC with modest timing differences. Reanchor efficiency research to direct_lifted (0.630432 AUC, 25.02 s inference), using sketch256 (0.620337, 18.15 s) as the observed cost/utility tradeoff; single-seed results remain provisional.

lanes.active_topic_title: Incremental utility of target-conditioned readout with pooled observed histories

topics.title: 表示学习与训练信号
topics.question: 哪些明确注册的训练信号能提升历史表示的可用性，且额外训练成本或推理成本可接受？
topics.hypothesis: 针对已有信息缺口的学习目标可能改善有限预算下的表示获取；需要等训练量和通用正则化对照，不能只延续某一梯度解释。

topics.title: Compatibility of grouped history evidence and target-conditioned readout
topics.question: Does combining the strongest history representation with target-conditioned readout outperform both frozen source bests, especially paired_match, under the same visible inputs and training protocol, with capacity and measured cost controlled?
topics.hypothesis: The separate source gains motivate testing whether target-conditioned readout can use information retained by grouped history representations. They do not establish complementary mechanisms and may reflect redundant target matching. Preserve both frozen source bests as utility controls and use matched-capacity, target-independent readout controls to distinguish conditioning from extra capacity. Failure to exceed paired_match would leave incremental utility unsupported; gains matched by the target-independent control would leave conditioning unsupported. Reserve budget for attribution and repetition, and report training and inference cost alongside AUC and logloss.

topics.title: Incremental utility of target-conditioned readout with pooled observed histories
topics.question: Under the frozen visible inputs and training protocol, does combining pooled_observed history representation with the current target-conditioned readout outperform both frozen source bests, especially pooled_observed, after controlling for extra capacity, redundant evidence and measured training/inference cost?
topics.hypothesis: Target-conditioned readout may expose predictive relationships beyond those already captured by pooled_observed, but the small recent target/context contrast and shared history-representation ancestry make redundancy plausible. Retain both frozen source bests as utility controls and compare target-conditioned versus target-independent readout with matched capacity and duplicated-evidence controls. An advantage over pooled_observed that survives these controls and repetition would support incremental utility; failure to beat that stronger source, or an advantage reproduced by target-independent capacity or duplicated evidence, would leave complementarity unsupported. Measure parameters and training/inference cost, and reserve the remaining budget for attribution, repetition and final assessment. The compact evidence establishes neither the mechanism nor novelty.

decisions.reason: After 24 attempts, the current topic gains only 0.000272 AUC and recent controls remain near baseline. History representation and target-conditioned readout show provisional gains of 0.005747 and 0.001973. Their compatibility is unresolved; the existing statistics/groups combination also failed to beat its entry source. Retain both frozen bests, compare against the stronger source, and account for capacity and measured training/inference cost.

decisions.reason: Compatibility remains unresolved: balanced_target (AUC 0.620230) trails coupled_context (0.620691). The recent equal-parameter factorial shows negligible target benefit with slots and a loss with collapsed history; all four trail balanced_target. Continue the controlled compatibility comparison against both frozen source bests and target-independent readout, accounting for capacity and measured cost. Balanced_target and coupled_context have similar inference times (~21.1s); single-seed gains remain provisional.

pooled_observed reaches AUC 0.630275; the current best remains 0.620230 after 48 attempts, and the latest equal-parameter step target/context gap is only 0.000222. Both sources improve on their entry references and DIN, but these single-seed gains do not establish compatibility. Test incremental utility over the stronger pooled source with capacity, redundancy and measured-cost controls.
